title: Evidence: Boba Fett Figure Condition Photos

attachments.platform_description: Close-up of both knee joints showing paint worn through to the green plastic underneath. Left knee has approximately 3mm x 5mm bare spot. Right knee has similar-sized wear area.
attachments.title: Photo 1: Knee Joint Paint Wear

attachments.platform_description: Side-by-side photo of the received blaster (left) next to a reference 1979 Kenner Boba Fett blaster identified by the submitter as authenticated original (right). The received blaster has a visibly smoother, more uniform plastic texture compared to the slightly grainy texture of the reference item.
attachments.title: Photo 2: Blaster Comparison

attachments.platform_description: Close-up of the blaster mold seam line. A faint seam line is visible along the barrel. The seam is notably smooth and uniform compared to typical vintage mold lines.
attachments.title: Photo 3: Blaster Mold Detail

attachments.platform_description: Full figure photo showing overall condition. The figure body and limbs are in good condition. The knee joint areas documented in Photo 1 and the blaster documented in Photos 2-3 are visible in this overview.
attachments.title: Photo 4: Overall Figure
